      <h1 class="hero-name">Dominik Graetz</h1>
      <p class="hero-bio">
        I study <strong>attentional control</strong> and the <strong>exploitation–exploration tradeoff</strong> —
        how decision variables like response speed, reward, and uncertainty shape whether we rely on
        internal representations or consult the environment. I work with behavioral experiments,
        eye-tracking, and computational modeling across younger and older adult populations.
